active_rules.title: Wrong Network
active_rules.description: Explicit configured network differs from node-reported chain.
required_context: explicit network and bound Bitcoin Core node context

active_rules.title: Excessive Absolute Fee
active_rules.description: Fee exceeds the configured absolute development limit.

active_rules.title: Excessive Fee Percentage
active_rules.description: Fee share of total input value exceeds the configured development limit.

active_rules.title: Unknown Wallet Input
active_rules.description: Resolved prevout has no descriptor match within the configured derivation window.

active_rules.title: Unknown Change Output
active_rules.description: Explicitly expected change does not match the internal keychain (HIGH external match; CRITICAL no match).

active_rules.title: Immature Coinbase Input
active_rules.description: Node-reported coinbase has fewer than 100 confirmations.
required_context: explicit network and bound Bitcoin Core node context

active_rules.title: Invalid UTXO Context
active_rules.description: Supplied previous-output metadata is internally inconsistent.

active_rules.title: Missing UTXO Context
active_rules.description: Previous-output information is missing, preventing reliable fee evaluation.

active_rules.title: Unusual Sighash Type
active_rules.description: An explicit sighash differs from SIGHASH_DEFAULT or SIGHASH_ALL.

active_rules.title: Unknown or Proprietary Metadata
active_rules.description: PSBT contains extension metadata that TxSignX does not interpret.

active_rules.title: Unrecognized Script Type
active_rules.description: An output or resolved prevout uses an unrecognized script template.

active_rules.title: Non-Zero OP_RETURN Value
active_rules.description: Positive value is assigned to a provably unspendable OP_RETURN output.

active_rules.title: Node UTXO Unavailable
active_rules.description: Outpoint is unavailable in the node's queried UTXO views.
required_context: explicit network and bound Bitcoin Core node context

active_rules.title: Node Prevout Mismatch
active_rules.description: Resolved PSBT prevout disagrees with node-reported value or script.
required_context: explicit network and bound Bitcoin Core node context

active_rules.title: Mempool Spend Conflict
active_rules.description: Chain UTXO is absent from the node's mempool-aware view.
required_context: explicit network and bound Bitcoin Core node context

deferred_rules.title: Dust Output
deferred_rules.description: Reserved / deferred; not evaluated in Milestone 5.
required_context: explicit relay/dust policy assumptions or node policy context

deferred_rules.title: Address Reuse
deferred_rules.description: Reserved / deferred; not evaluated in Milestone 5.
